# Code

## Packages 
```{r, include=FALSE}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "asciiSetupReader", "Amelia", "jtools", "mice", "parameters", "performance", "reformulas", "TMB", "glmmTMB", "sjmisc", "insight", "ggmice", "ggplot2"))

#install.packages("TMB", type = "source") #if you have issues installing
#install.packages("glmmTMB", type = "source") #if you have issues installing

library(tidyverse)
library(asciiSetupReader)
library(naniar)
library(mice)
library(Amelia)
library(jtools)
library(srvyr)
library(mice)
library(parameters)  # model summaries - comments from Merchant et al.      
library(performance) # model fit indices, ICC - comments from Merchant et al. 
library(glmmTMB)     # multilevel modelling - comments from Merchant et al. 
library(sjmisc)
library(insight)
library(ggmice)
library(ggplot2)
```


## Data Loading and Initial Processing

### Loading YRBS Data 2019
```{r, warning = FALSE}

#Loaded Data using asciiSetupReader
datam19_1 <- read_ascii_setup("2019/sadc_2019_state_a_m.dat", "2019/2019-sadc-spss-input-program.sps", 
                           use_clean_names = FALSE) 
datnz19_1 <- read_ascii_setup("2019/sadc_2019_state_n_z.dat", "2019/2019-sadc-spss-input-program.sps", 
                           use_clean_names = FALSE) 

#Kept original dataset for further manipulation 
datam19 <- datam19_1 
datnz19 <- datnz19_1

```

### Creating Dataset for Unweighted Analysis for YRBSS 2017 AND 2019
```{r}

#Selecting variables/columns of interest 
datam19 <- datam19 %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

datnz19 <- datnz19 %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

#Dataset with all states - kept for potential  manipulation 
yrbs19_1 <- bind_rows(datam19, datnz19) 


#Cleaning dataset -> replacing periods with NA, changing names, and making
#categorical variables factors and matching ref group to that of the study
yrbs1719 <- yrbs19_1 %>% 
  mutate(race7 =  na_if(race7, "."), 
         sexid =  na_if(sexid, "."), 
         sex = na_if(sex, ".")
         ) %>% 
  filter(year >= 2017) %>% 
  rename(state = sitecode, 
         raceid = race7,
         considered_suicide = q26
  )%>% 
  mutate_at(c("raceid", "sex", "sexid", "considered_suicide"), as.factor)%>% 
  mutate(raceid = fct_relevel(raceid, "White"), 
         sex    = fct_relevel(sex, "Male"), 
         sexid  = fct_relevel(sexid, "Heterosexual"))
  

#Checking cleaned dataset
head(yrbs1719)
str(yrbs1719)


```

### Loading YRBS Data 2021
```{r, warning = FALSE}

#Loaded Data using asciiSetupReader
datad1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_a_d.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                           use_clean_names = FALSE)
dateh1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_e_h.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                            use_clean_names = FALSE)
datil1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_I_L.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                            use_clean_names = FALSE)
datmp1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_Q_T.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                            use_clean_names = FALSE)
datqt1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_M_P.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                            use_clean_names = FALSE)
datuz1 <- read_ascii_setup("2021/SADC_2021_State_U_Z.dat", "2021/2021-SADC-SPSS-Input-Program.sps", 
                            use_clean_names = FALSE)

#Kept original dataset for further manipulation 
datad <- datad1
```

### Creating Dataset for Unweighted Analysis for YRBSS 2021
```{r}

#Selecting variables/columns of interest 
datad <- datad %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

dateh <- dateh %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

datil <- datil %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

datmp <- datmp %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)


datqt <- datqt %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)

datuz <- datuz %>% 
  select(sitecode, year, race7, sexid, q26, sex)


yrbs21_1 <- bind_rows(datad,dateh, datil, datmp, datqt, datuz)


#Cleaning dataset -> replacing periods with NA, changing names, and making
#categorical variables factors and matching ref group to that of the study
yrbs21 <- yrbs21_1 %>% 
  mutate(race7 =  na_if(race7, "."), 
         sexid =  na_if(sexid, "."), 
         sex   = na_if(sex, ".")
         ) %>% 
  filter(year >= 2021) %>% 
  rename(state = sitecode, 
         raceid = race7,
         considered_suicide = q26
  )%>% 
  mutate_at(c("raceid", "sex", "sexid", "considered_suicide"), as.factor)%>% 
  mutate(raceid = fct_relevel(raceid, "White"), 
         sex    = fct_relevel(sex, "Male"), 
         sexid  = fct_relevel(sexid, "Heterosexual"))
  

#Checking cleaned dataset
head(yrbs21)
str(yrbs21)



```

### Creating Dataset for Unweighted Analysis for YRBSS 2017, 2019, 2021

```{r}

yrbs <- rbind(yrbs1719, yrbs21)

head(yrbs)
str(yrbs)

saveRDS(yrbs, file = "yrbs_preimputation.rds")

```

## Missing Data

### Confirm that dataset matches study and has similar missing data 
```{r}

#Filtering by year to check sample size and distribution for each year 

#2017 
yrbs17 <- yrbs1719 %>% 
  filter(year == 2017)

yrbs17 %>% 
  mutate(complete = complete.cases(yrbs17)) %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarize(
    obs_state = n(),
    complete = sum(complete),
    across(c(considered_suicide, sex, raceid, sexid), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))

#2019
yrbs19 <- yrbs1719 %>% 
  filter(year == 2019)

yrbs19 %>% 
  mutate(complete = complete.cases(yrbs19)) %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarize(
    obs_state = n(),
    complete = sum(complete),
    across(c(considered_suicide, sex, raceid, sexid), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))

#2021 
yrbs21 %>% 
  mutate(complete = complete.cases(yrbs21)) %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarize(
    obs_state = n(),
    complete = sum(complete),
    across(c(considered_suicide, sex, raceid, sexid), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))

#Total sample
yrbs %>% 
  mutate(complete = complete.cases(yrbs)) %>%

  summarize(
    obs_state = n(),
    complete = sum(complete),
    across(c(considered_suicide, sex, raceid, sexid), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

### Heatmap for Unweighted Data 
```{r}
#2017 and 2019
m_yrbs1719 <- yrbs %>% 
  filter(year <= 2019) %>% 
  select(- year, - state)

missmap(
  m_yrbs1719, 
  main = "Missing Data Heatmap YRBSS Data 2017 and 2019", 
  col  = c("royalblue", "lightgreen"), 
  legend = T
)

#2021 
m_yrbs21 <- yrbs %>% 
  filter(year == 2021)


missmap(
  m_yrbs21, 
  main = "Missing Data Heatmap YRBSS Data 2021", 
  col  = c("royalblue", "lightgreen"), 
  legend = T
)

m_yrbs <- yrbs %>% 
  select(- year, - state)

#Combo 
missmap(
  m_yrbs, 
  main = "Missing Data Heatmap YRBSS Data Combo", 
  col  = c("royalblue", "lightgreen"), 
  legend = T
)
```


### Missing Data Barchart Unweighted
```{r}
gg_miss_upset(yrbs)
```

### MCAR Test Unweighted 
```{r}


#Little's Test --> reject null hypothesis that data is MCAR so we know that data is MAR OR MNAR
mcar_test(yrbs)

```

### MAR Test Unweighted  - Outcome 
```{r}


yrbsmiss <- yrbs

#Creating a column for missing values / NA = 1, observed = 0
yrbsmiss$y.miss = ifelse(is.na(yrbsmiss$considered_suicide), 1, 0)

colnames(yrbsmiss)
table(yrbsmiss$y.miss) 

#Running logisic regression to see if covariates can explain the missingness
glm1 <- glm(y.miss ~ sex + raceid + sexid, data = yrbsmiss, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summ(glm1, exp = TRUE)
```

### MAR Test Unweighted  - Covariates 
```{r}

#Creating a column for missing values / NA = 1, observed = 0
yrbsmiss$raceid_m <- as.numeric(is.na(yrbsmiss$raceid))
  
yrbsmiss$sex_m <- as.numeric(is.na(yrbsmiss$sex))

yrbsmiss$sexid_m <- as.numeric(is.na(yrbsmiss$sexid))


#Running logisic regression to see if the other variables can explain the missingness
glm2 <- glm(raceid_m ~ sex + sexid + considered_suicide, data = yrbsmiss, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
glm2

glm3 <- glm(sex_m ~ raceid + sexid + considered_suicide, data = yrbsmiss, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

glm4 <- glm(sexid_m ~ raceid + sex + considered_suicide, data = yrbsmiss, family = binomial(link = "logit"))


summ(glm2, exp = TRUE)
summ(glm3, exp = TRUE)
summ(glm4, exp = TRUE)

```

## MAIHDA Analysis

### MICE 
```{r}

library(mice)
str(yrbs)
yrbs_imputted <- mice(yrbs, m = 5, seed = 123)

#imputted data includes 3 mil observations now 
head(yrbs_imputted)

#Save file 
saveRDS(yrbs_imputted, file = "yrbs_imputted.rds")

#Going to create a dataset with a random sample of 520,000 to check diagnostics 

#Quality check --> seems to be good
plot(yrbs_imputted)

#Proportions --> dataset too big, was difficult to do any other diagnostic check --> just shows stability of imputations 

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$considered_suicide, complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$.imp), margin = 2), digits = 2)

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$sexid, complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$.imp), margin = 2), digits = 2)

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$raceid, complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$.imp), margin = 2), digits = 2)

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$sex, complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$.imp), margin = 2), digits = 2)

#Similarity with preimputation dataset --> was difficult to plot so shown numerically 
round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$considered_suicide,  complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$sexid)), digits = 2)
round(prop.table(table(yrbs$considered_suicide, yrbs$sexid)), digits = 2)

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$considered_suicide,  complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$raceid)), digits = 2)
round(prop.table(table(yrbs$considered_suicide, yrbs$raceid)), digits = 2)

round(prop.table(table(complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$considered_suicide,  complete(yrbs_imputted, "long")$sex)), digits = 2)
round(prop.table(table(yrbs$considered_suicide, yrbs$sex)), digits = 2)

yrbs_imputted <- readRDS("yrbs_imputted.rds")


```


### MAIHDA ANALYSIS 

```{r}

#Null Model --> code from Merchant et al. 
m_null <- with(yrbs_imputted, 
               glmmTMB(considered_suicide ~ 1 + ( 1 | sex:raceid:sexid), data = environment (), family=binomial(link='logit')))


icc1 <- sapply(m_null$analyses, icc)

icc1

#unadjusted ICC
mean(0.1019387, 0.10180940, 0994824, 0.102079, 0.1017482)*100

#Fixed effects 
 
 m_2 <- with(yrbs_imputted2_m, 
               glmmTMB(considered_suicide ~  1 +  prepost2020 + ( 1 | sex:raceid:sexid), data = environment (), family=binomial(link='logit')))


icc2 <- sapply(m_2$analyses, icc)

icc2

#unadjusted ICC
mean(.1008932, 0.1007225, 0.09838583, 0.1010178, 0.1005722)*100

#Random effects model 

 m_3 <- with(yrbs_imputted2_m, 
               glmmTMB(considered_suicide ~ 1 +  prepost2020 + ( prepost2020| sex:raceid:sexid), data = environment (), family=binomial(link='logit')))


icc3 <- sapply(m_3$analyses, icc)

#adjusted ICC
iccadj_m3 <- mean(0.1010607, 0.1006816, 0.0989893, 0.10115, .1006593)*100

#unadjusted
iccunadj_m3 <- mean(0.1010567, 0.1006761, 0.09898668, 0.1011461, 0.1006553)*100


#Crude Relative bias
((.11 - .10 )/ .10)*100


#Get variance to calculate year specific ICC

m3var <- sapply(m_3$analyses, get_variance)

#Calculate mean of the imputed values 
var.residual <- mean(3.289868, 3.289868, 3.289868, 3.289868, 3.289868) 

#rho 
cor.slope_intercept <- mean(-0.2186674, -0.2405494, -0.1253853, -0.1742017, -0.2369491)

#random intercept variance
var.intercept <- mean(0.3810894, 0.3808541, 0.3655358, 0.3777736, 0.3805615)  

#random slope variance
var.slope <- mean (0.007185732, 0.00660776, 0.006515971, 0.005925384, 0.006718819)

#Obtain covariance 
#rho * sd(var.slope) + sd(var.intercept)
#to get standard deviation take the square root
covariance <- cor.slope_intercept * sqrt(var.slope) * sqrt(var.intercept)

#Calculate unexplained between-stratum variance
var_unex <- var.slope + covariance + var.intercept

#calculate year specific ICC
post2020icc <- (var_unex / (var_unex + 3.29))*100
pre2020icc <- (var.intercept / (var.intercept + 3.29))* 100

#Compare ICCs 
iccadj_m3
iccunadj_m3
pre2020icc
post2020icc

```
